summary: Starts a telemetry output session: tears down previous telemetry state, checks the scoring gate, scans the live vehicle array for the active player slot, opens the output file/directory via sub_587DB0, computes the sampling rate (clamped to 1-40 Hz), then writes a CSV-style header with all telemetry channel column names, embeds XML scene configuration, and appends integrity checksums (pseudo-random, XOR/arithmetic-obfuscated vehicle/tyre/session values) plus XOR-decoded driver telemetry data. Frees all scratch allocations before returning.

local_names.this: telemetry session object (file handle +0x0, rate +0x4, byte offsets +0xC/+0x10/+0x14, counter +0x18)
local_names.v3: active player vehicle slot pointer (selected from vehicle ptr array)
local_names.v38: scratch checksum value (XOR-obfuscated before sub_4D5BE0 write)
local_names.v40: 4 random seed bytes read from the file header
local_names.v44: reallocated scene-path string buffer (freed at end)
local_names.v49: scene name buffer (extension stripped, seed suffix appended)
local_names.v52: vehicle name string (from vehicle database array entry)
local_names.v53: driver name string (copied from vehicle slot +18324)

operations.description: Destroy/tear down any previously allocated telemetry state via ResourceDestroy(this).
Gate on ScoringGateCheck(); if it returns zero, abort immediately and return the gate result.
Scan dword_7C54F0[] (vehicle pointer array) from 0 while index < dword_5C329C, looking for the first slot whose int32 at +13000 equals 0 (the active/free player slot); stop on the first match.

Only proceed when a player slot was found (loop index != dword_5C329C) and the output path from dword_7CEA34 (fallback byte_5EA438) is non-empty, dword_7CE9D0 > 0, and (dword_7C56A4 != 7 or dword_7CE9F4).
Open the telemetry output directory/stream via sub_587DB0(path, &unk_5C2AB0); store the resulting handle into this+0x0.
Compute sampling rate as 10 * CRTFtol(40.0 / dword_7CE9D0 + 0.5) into this+0x4, then clamp it to the 1..40 range (40 if above, 1 if below).
Read 4 bytes (1 element, size 4) from the file handle via FileReadWrapperWithLock into scratch v48.
Generate 4 random bytes v40[0..3] with RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator and write them to the file via FileReadWrapperWithLock.
Derive header byte offsets from the random seed bytes: this+0xC = v12 + v11 + 18, this+0x10 = v41 + v11 + 77, this+0x14 = v16 + v14 + 15, and this+0x18 = 0.
Write the magic header integer 1028443341 via sub_4D5BE0.
Write the player vehicle's three name/description strings (at slot+17952, slot+18040, slot+18196) and the scene path from dword_7CE5EC (fallback byte_5EA438) via sub_4D5BE0.
Write the constant 57 (v46) as 4 bytes and the field delimiter byte 4 (v37) as 1 byte via sub_4D5BE0.

Write the base telemetry column-name headers, each NUL-terminated string separated by the delimiter byte 4: ElapsedTime, PosX, PosY, PosZ, Yaw, LatAccel, VertAccel, LongAccel, EngineRPM, ClutchRPM, UnfilteredThrottle, Throttle, UnfilteredBrake, Brake, UnfilteredSteering, Steering, UnfilteredClutch, Clutch.

Per-wheel header loop k=0..3 selecting wheel prefix aFl/aFr/aRl/aRr, writing nine per-wheel channel names (WheelspinRadsS, SuspensionDefl, UndertrayRideH, TyreLeftTempK, TyreCenterTemp, TyreRightTempK, TyrePressureKpa, TyreWear, CornerWeight) each as prefix+channel string plus delimiter byte via sub_4D5BE0.
Write the final column headers Gear, WaterTemperatu, OilTemperature (each with delimiter byte) via sub_4D5BE0.
Copy the vehicle name into v52 from the vehicle-database string entry at 1060 * slotIndex + dword_8AC394 + 8 (fallback byte_5EA438), then copy the driver name from slot+18324 into v53.
Clear the 256-byte v54 buffer via sub_4CEEF0.
Build the scene name: copy v49 from the path at dword_7CE5D0 (fallback byte_5EA438) with sub_587DD0, strip the '.' extension suffix, then append the dword_5C5D24 integer and byte_5C5D28 seed bytes.
Initialize scratch tyre-model data (TireModelDataInit) and session struct (SessionStructInit), then parse the vehicle name v52 into the session struct via TheSvmHdvVehicleFileParser(v52, v61, 2).

Write integrity checksum block: deterministic pseudo-random values from DeterministicHashPseudoRandomGenerator(&dword_8AAE70), tyre/vehicle values via UtilityFunction_8a60 selectors (40, 151, 4, 148, 153, 26, 161, 82, 242) with XOR/multiply/add obfuscation constants (0x12F3DCAA, 355, 0x516141F2 from flt_7C935C, 1559, 0x2033DAAA, 0x7711DAAB, 69017, 0x7123456C, 59015, 0x99009977, 49414, 0xEEAC5370, 330358, 0x4940AF7E, 1121110*dword_8ACED8+1819630500 XOR 0x12131415, 9*(dword_7C56B8+468717589) XOR 0xABBA717E, 15833346 XOR 0xF12003), each flushed via sub_4D5BE0.
Copy the scene path dword_7CE5D0 (fallback byte_5EA438) into a reallocated buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, then strip its extension at the '.' suffix.

Iterate dword_8AC488 entries (stride 396) starting at dword_8AC490; for each entry sub_588410(path, entry+4) reports a hit, XOR-accumulate (445 * dword@entry+392) ^ 0xFEC950A4 into v38; the accumulated value is flushed via sub_4D5BE0.
Read and XOR-decode the driver telemetry data from the file via FileReadWithXORDecode(v53).
Free all scratch allocations: v44, v62, v60, v59, v58, v57, v56, v55[0] via FreeWrapper_7bcf and the score/timing scratch v63 via ScoreSlotDeallocator.
Return the last result (the FreeWrapper_7bcf return for v55[0] when non-null, else the open-handle/gate result). Invoked from sub_4A00A0.

clean_pseudocode: read 4 bytes seed; write 4 random bytes;
derive this->+0xC/+0x10/+0x14 from seed bytes; this->+0x18 = 0;
write magic 1028443341; write vehicle name strings and scene path; write 57 and delimiter 4;
write base channel headers, per-wheel channel headers, gear/water/oil headers;
copy vehicle name v52 and driver name v53;
sub_4CEEF0(v54, 256); build scene name v49 (strip ext, append seed);
write obfuscated integrity checksums via sub_4D5BE0;
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(scene path); loop sub_588410 over dword_8AC488 entries;
